Card Q&A.q: When my opponent declares an attack on this Digimon, can I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to place a card with [Etemon]/[Sukamon] in its name from my hand on top of my security stack but choose to not switch the target of attack?
Can I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to switch the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack to my opponent?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's play cost 3 or lower Digimon or Tamers. For each card with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name in your trash, add 1 to the maximum play cost this effect can choose.

[Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, by placing 1 card with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name from your hand on top of your security stack, you may switch the target of attack to this Digimon or the player.
